domains.referenceAuthority: Craig, J.J. (2005) Introduction to Robotics: Mechanics and Control, Pearson 3rd Ed. / ISO 9283:1998
domains.physicalInvariant: Rigid metric link lengths l_i >= 0, payload mass m >= 0
domains.boundaryContract: l_1 < 0 || l_2 < 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION; m = 0 -> valid (zero gravity torque)

domains.referenceAuthority: ICAO Doc 7488/3 / ISO 2533:1975 Standard Atmosphere Tables
domains.physicalInvariant: Standard atmospheric model valid domain 0 <= h <= 80,000 m
domains.boundaryContract: h < 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION; h = 0 -> valid (sea level); h > 80,000 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION

domains.referenceAuthority: SAE J2263 Road Load / Hucho, W.-H. (1998) Aerodynamics of Road Vehicles 4th Ed
domains.physicalInvariant: Aerodynamic drag coefficient C_d >= 0 (2nd Law of Thermodynamics)
domains.boundaryContract: C_d < 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION; v = 0 -> valid (static vehicle); A <= 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION

domains.referenceAuthority: IEC 61400-1:2019 Wind Turbines / Betz, A. (1919) 1D Actuator Disk Momentum Theory
domains.boundaryContract: C_p > 16/27 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION; v_wind = 0 -> valid (calm air); eta > 100% -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION

domains.referenceAuthority: ITTC 1957 Model-Ship Correlation Line / SNAME Principles of Naval Architecture Vol II
domains.physicalInvariant: Froude scaling number F_n = v / sqrt(g*L) requires L > 0

domains.referenceAuthority: ASME B31.8-2020 Gas Transmission and Distribution Piping / API Specification 5L
domains.physicalInvariant: Barlow hoop stress sigma_h = (P*D)/(2*t) requires t > 0, D > 0, P >= 0
domains.boundaryContract: t <= 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION; P = 0 -> valid (zero stress baseline); P < 0 -> PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION
